title: My Favorite Months
text:
My favorite month is July. It is hot and sunny in July. My birthday is on July 15. On my birthday, I go to the beach with my family.

February is a short month. It has only 28 days. In February, it is cold where I live. My friend's birthday is on February 2, and we have a party at her house.

questions.text: What is the narrator's favorite month?
How many days does February have?
How does the narrator probably feel about summer?
options: The narrator likes it very much
The narrator does not like it
The narrator is afraid of it
The narrator never thinks about it

questions.text: What can we guess about the weather at the friend's party?
options: It is probably very hot outside
It is probably snowing in July
It is probably raining every day of the year

vocabulary.definition: the one you like the most
an area of sand next to the sea
a happy event where friends meet and have fun

paragraph_translations: Mi mes favorito es julio. En julio hace calor y sol. Mi cumpleaños es el 15 de julio. En mi cumpleaños, voy a la playa con mi familia.
Febrero es un mes corto. Solo tiene 28 días. En febrero hace frío donde yo vivo. El cumpleaños de mi amiga es el 2 de febrero, y tenemos una fiesta en su casa.
